text:
You won’t believe what happened! The whole city just… stopped. No lights, no noise from the cars, nothing. It was like someone hit a giant pause button on everything. But we went up to our rooftop garden, right? And guess what? It didn’t get dark in there!

Well, not really dark. The stars came out so bright it looked like glitter spilled all over the sky. I’ve never seen that many before! Mom said it’s because the city lights usually wash them away, but now they’re super visible. And the air felt different, you know? Cooler and quieter.

The plants were still glowing a little bit with those tiny solar lights we installed last week. They look like fireflies resting on the leaves. We sat on the bench and ate apples in the moonlight. It’s spooky-cool, kind of like being on another planet, but safe. I think I like the quiet better than the loud honking anyway. Do you have any stars where you live?
